merge_basis: Candidate T0026 covers Zongertinib study 1479-0044 (1L NSCLC combo, Ph2), which is a distinct study number and indication/line from all existing Zongertinib groups: G0003 (1L NSCLC NDA approval), G0011 (IIS NSCLC), G0012 (Beamion Breast-2, 1479-0017), G0015 (Beamion Gastric-1, 1479-0013), G0016 (Beamion LUNG-3, 1479-0032), G0019 (ECR/RWE 1479-0042), G0021 (Beamion Pan-tumor-1, 1479-0009), G0023 (Beamion BCGC-1, 1479-0012), G0024 (Beamion Breast-1, 1479-0016). No existing group matches study number 1479-0044; this is a new topic.
